sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Kunal Jain - learned counsel for the petitioner.

This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 04.09.2024 passed in M.A.C.C.
No.116/2024 by the learned Member, MACT, District Alirajpur (MP), whereby the claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 17.01.2024 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 22.06.2023 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No.9152/2023.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17563 2 MP-719-2025 in MACC No.116/2024.
4.
I have heard counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with Bharti Axa Lombard General Insurance ... vs Deepak S/O Besan Baghel Minor Through ... on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82009211/
1 the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
6.

entities.text: Bharti Axa Lombard General Insurance ... vs Deepak S/O Besan Baghel Minor

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observation, this miscellaneous petition is disposed of.
